All objectives are complete and verified. Final report:

**Objective 1 — DONE.** The provisioned dashboard `Service health` (URL: http://127.0.0.1:3000/d/bench-service-health/service-health, folder "Bench") contains exactly 3 panels, titled as shown: **Request rate**, **Error count**, **Latency by endpoint**.

**Objective 2 — DONE.** New dashboard created and saved, titled **`fwgr14-n1 Bench Dashboard`**, containing a **Stat** panel titled **`fwgr14-n1 Availability`** whose query uses the TestData data source (verified in the saved dashboard JSON: panel type `stat`, datasource `{"type":"grafana-testdata-datasource","uid":"benchtestdata"}`). The panel renders a live A-series value.

**Objective 3 — DONE.** The same dashboard contains a **Text** panel titled **`fwgr14-n1 Notes`** (panel type `text`) whose rendered content is "Notes for run fwgr14-n1" — it includes the runid. Saved.

**Objective 4 — DONE.** The dashboard's saved tags array is `["bench"]`, and its saved time range is `{"from":"now-6h","to":"now"}` (the top-right picker shows "Last 6 hours"). Persisted by checking "Update default time range" in the save dialog.

**Objective 5 — DONE.** The dashboard's saved `refresh` value is **`1m`**, shown next to the time picker on the dashboard page. Persisted by checking "Update default refresh value" in the save dialog.

**Objective 6 — DONE.** Dashboard URL: **http://127.0.0.1:3000/d/ffwqqxueqwgzkb/fwgr14-n1-bench-dashboard** — UID: **`ffwqqxueqwgzkb`**.

All values above were read back from the saved dashboard via the Grafana API (`/api/dashboards/uid/ffwqqxueqwgzkb`) and from the rendered dashboard page, so they reflect persisted state rather than unsaved editor changes.
